name: NDA Clause Checklist
description: Checks whether standard NDA clause types appear to be present in given contract text. A completeness screening aid only — NOT legal advice on whether the NDA is actually adequate.

tools.name: check_nda_checklist
tools.description: Scans contract text for keyword sets associated with standard NDA clause types (confidentiality, term, exceptions, remedies, governing law) and reports which appear present.
